728-1286-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ajani's Chosen triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ajani's Chosen triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat from step 3.

955-2034-5477-5660-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate the Plant by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the tapped Plant, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

141-2438-5188.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-2438-5188.description:
Cast Dread Return by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Dread Return.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Dread Return
Resolve the Dread Return copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1806-2060-4772-6797-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Doubling Season.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

240-4785-5256-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat from step 2.

803-6705-7304.description:
Cast Genghis Frog either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {G}{U} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Genghis Frog enters, it triggers, creating a Mutagen token and a creature token due to Quina.
When the creature token enters as a Mutant due to Arcane Adaptation, Genghis Frog triggers, creating a Mutagen token and a creature token due to Quina.
Repeat step 3.
803-6705-7304.notes: Step 3 creates a mandatory infinite loop that will cause the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1233-1753-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1233-1753-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Squee as attackers.
Squee triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

4446-5170-6132-6797.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
4446-5170-6132-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Relic Vial triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Relic Vial trigger.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

2866-4211-4986-5231.description:
Cast Tormod's Crypt by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2428-5078-6900.description:
Activate Sense's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library from the battlefield.
Horizon Chimera triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

662-1651-5640-6857.description:
Activate Liquimetal Coating by tapping it, causing Kragma Butcher to become an artifact.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping it and Kragma Butcher, targeting Kragma Butcher.
Ertha Jo triggers, copying Clock of Omens' ability, targeting Clock of Omens.
Resolve both Clock of Omens abilities, untapping it and Kragma Butcher.
Kragma Butcher triggers, giving it +2/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 2.
662-1651-5640-6857.notes: You can tap a different artifact in place of Clock of Omens if desired.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet and with toughness 2 or greater

2665-2760-3108.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Progenitor Mimic.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Progenitor Mimic by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

2811-2919-3197.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2811-2919-3197.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Elas il-Kor triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

4871-5330-6291.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.

225-1479-5671-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
You are able to play a land this turn.
225-1479-5671-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and The Necrobloom trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the The Necrobloom trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, The Necrobloom and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the The Necrobloom trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, The Necrobloom triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

81-1909-4486.notablePrerequisites:
Kami of Whispered Hopes does not have summoning sickness.
Kami of Whispered Hopes has power 2 or greater who has at least a +1/+0 boost from secondary effects.
81-1909-4486.description:
Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Activate Mirror Entity by paying {1}, giving creatures you control all creature types and base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Repeat.
81-1909-4486.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Mirror Entity to make your creatures infinitely large until end of turn.

1495-4613-5735.notablePrerequisites:
Shay Cormac has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
You have a way to give Shay Cormac deathtouch.
1495-4613-5735.description:
Give Shay Cormac deathtouch, if needed.
Activate Shay Cormac using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting a creature an opponent controls.
Shay Cormac's first ability triggers, putting a bounty counter on the targeted creature.
Resolve the Shay Cormac ability from step 2, dealing 1 damage to the creature and killing it due to Shay Cormac's deathtouch.
When the creature dies, Shay Cormac's second ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.
If the method giving Shay Cormac deathtouch lasts indefinitely, you may repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-5189-5641.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1270-5189-5641.description:
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating three 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate an Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

509-662-1267-5547.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
509-662-1267-5547.description:
Activate Liquimetal Coating by tapping it, causing Medomai the Ageless to become an artifact until end of turn.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris and Thrummingbird.
Idris and Thrummingbird trigger.
Resolve the Idris trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Thrummingbird trigger, putting a time counter on Idris.
Repeat from step 6.

313-914-5147.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
313-914-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Corpse Dance with buyback by paying {4}{B}, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield, and then returning Corpse Dance to your hand.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{B}.
Repeat.
If opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

656-4396-5220.description:
Cast Ugin's Conjurant either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Ugin's Conjurant enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Ugin's Conjurant on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

147-2034-3331-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact, enchantment and/or token.
147-2034-3331-5220.description:
Cast Thunderous Debut by paying {6}{G}{G} and sacrificing an artifact, enchantment or token.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Thunderous Debut.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, adding {C}{C}.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Dualcaster Mage on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the copy of Thunderous Debut, causing you to look at the top twenty cards of your library and put Dualcaster Mage and up to one other creature card onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1528-3360-4036.notablePrerequisites:
Dual Casting attached to Torchling.
Torchling does not have summoning sickness.
1528-3360-4036.description:
Cast Seething Song by paying {2}{R}.
Holding priority, activate Torchling by paying {R} and tapping it, copying Seething Song.
Resolve the copy of Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Torchling by paying {R}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

147-1409-5211.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three lands.
147-1409-5211.description:
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying {6}{R}.
Holding priority, activate Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself.
Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Brass's Bounty.
Resolve the copy of Brass's Bounty, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat from step 2.

1479-3861-4862.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3861-4862.description:
Play Orzhov Basilica.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it, Omnath, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Omnath trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it and Omnath trigger.
Repeat from step 4.
